pseudoStyles.cssText: .ck.on::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 0px; width: 5px; height: 10px; border-top-color: ; border-top-style: ; border-right-color: ; border-right-style: ; border-bottom-color: ; border-bottom-style: ; border-left-color: ; border-left-style: ; border-image-source: ; border-image-slice: ; border-image-width: ; border-image-outset: ; border-image-repeat: ; border-width: 0px 2px 2px 0px; transform: rotate(45deg); }
